verdict.rationale: PostHog's CDP pipelines can send event data to Slack, PagerDuty, and other SaaS destinations, and can filter/reshape events and route them 'wherever it needs to go' in realtime, which implies webhook-style outbound delivery — but no evidence pack item explicitly names 'webhook' as a subscription mechanism or ties this to AI-agent consumption of the event stream. missing for 10: explicit webhook endpoint/subscription documentation, confirmation that arbitrary event streams can be pushed to a caller-defined webhook URL, and any AI-native usage example of subscribing via webhook.
